message.reasoning_content: Summarize the kernel and record description update. Notable: kernel's `output = output + tl.log(pivot)` — tl.log is FP32 log, tolerance 1e-4 relative. Elimination without pivoting: matrix updates only for rows>k and cols>k, but the "updated" is subtracted over whole matrix then masked — fine since lower rows, upper cols submatrix only matters. Also note: multiplier includes row k itself (column includes pivot value 1), that's fine. Risk: no pivoting but SPD so positive pivots; log accumulation in fp32; tl.log precision; determinism of make_inputs seed.
